## Workers Comp / CTP — Intake & Staging (Phase B)

Daily 6:30pm: reads the same Cliniko invoices as the NDIS workflow, but only processes lines coded with insurer fee-schedule items (e.g. WCP002) — NDIS-coded lines are left to the NDIS workflow.

Validates against funding_profiles: active profile, insurer claim number, current AHTR approval (reference + expiry), approved sessions remaining, and gazetted rate cap. Valid claims are STAGED in the ledger as pending_review — nothing is emailed to an insurer from this workflow. A digest email asks the reviewer to open the 2.3) Claims Review dashboard, where each claim gets final verification: approve (invoice emailed to insurer + sessions counted) or reject (reason saved). Claims already submitted / rejected / paid are never re-processed.

Failures → error report email, as before. Keep funding_profiles current and put real SIRA gazetted rates in insurer_fee_schedule.
